def arc_geometry(p1, p2, rx, ry, fa, fs):
    # SVG implementation notes F.6.5 / F.6.6 (phi is irrelevant since rx == ry)
    x1, y1 = p1
    x2, y2 = p2
    dx = (x1 - x2) / 2.0
    dy = (y1 - y2) / 2.0
    lam = (dx * dx) / (rx * rx) + (dy * dy) / (ry * ry)
    if lam > 1.0:
        s = math.sqrt(lam)
        rx *= s
        ry *= s
    num = rx * rx * ry * ry - rx * rx * dy * dy - ry * ry * dx * dx
    den = rx * rx * dy * dy + ry * ry * dx * dx
    co = math.sqrt(max(0.0, num / den))
    if fa == fs:
        co = -co
    cxp = co * rx * dy / ry
    cyp = -co * ry * dx / rx
    cx = cxp + (x1 + x2) / 2.0
    cy = cyp + (y1 + y2) / 2.0

    t1 = math.atan2((y1 - cy) / ry, (x1 - cx) / rx)
    t2 = math.atan2((y2 - cy) / ry, (x2 - cx) / rx)
    d = t2 - t1
    if fs == 1 and d < 0:
        d += 2 * math.pi
    if fs == 0 and d > 0:
        d -= 2 * math.pi
    if fa == 1 and abs(d) < math.pi:

    tm = t1 + d / 2.0
    mid = (cx + rx * math.cos(tm), cy + ry * math.sin(tm))
    return cx, cy, rx, ry, mid
